# CSR email inclusion controls the subject alternative name

The account UI asks whether to include the identity email, then passes that email or an empty string to nsICertGen.gen. The C++ code adds an RFC 822 subject alternative name only when email is nonempty. The request subject itself is empty. Review caught a checkbox state error introduced by the back loop; the author corrected it and reported checking both checkbox states. For future changes, test both resulting CSR forms and the back path. This study did not execute the UI.

Scope: S/MIME certificate requests.

Paths:

- `mailnews/extensions/smime/nsCertGen.cpp`
- `mail/extensions/am-e2e/am-e2e.js`
